config.preprocess:
ImageClassification(
    crop_size=[224]
    resize_size=[256]
    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406]
    std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
    interpolation=InterpolationMode.BILINEAR
)
config.target: FP32 original Top-1, fixed across all perturbations
config.perturbation_precision: FP16 only after measured pilot gate; otherwise FP32
config.cam_backward: FP32 CUDA autograd; deterministic algorithms off in the performance stage; no bitwise guarantee
config.id_cuda_performance: cuDNN benchmark on; deterministic algorithms off; fixed seeds, no bitwise guarantee
config.cka: exact centered feature-space covariance, float64; no NxN matrices
config.random_ties: seeded per-image random initial order; stable descending CAM sort
config.bootstrap: 1000 paired class-cluster resamples; exploratory class-composition sensitivity
